name: fault_ecg_electrode_refitted_standstill
description: ANH-176, the detached electrode: 50 s without a heart rate during WARMUP of the shipped 30-min programme (FREEZE at 10 s, REDUCE at 30 s, the setpoint reaches zero), then the electrode is refitted. The session must END at that standstill, latched (session_standstill): a stopped arm never restarts by itself, so nothing moves when the heart rate returns, and a START is refused until a named acknowledgement.
